sentences.en: Despite the importance of sleep, its purpose is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 尽管睡眠很重要，但它的目的仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: Despite having lived near the sea, she still cannot swim.
sentences.zh: 尽管她住在海边，但她仍然不会游泳。

sentences.en: Despite his young age, he did a very good job.
sentences.zh: 尽管年纪很小，但他做得非常好。
